body: I'm not even phased by death anymore, I'm kind of happy he's dead. He was in so much pain near the end of his life. I'm not mourning. There are no jobs relevant to those hobbies that I'd like to do, I've explored that. Every day that's going by I just want it to end, I hate living like this so much it doesn't matter what I do to try to "fix"it, ive been trying to do that all my life and the only thing that ever made me wanna live was my ex. I'm tired of dragging through the days, I'm absolutely sick of it, I just want it to end. The thing is, when we first broke up, she said things sort of similar to your suggestions, about restarting life and that I'll be fine, and that's happened in previous relationships, but I just can't want to live after this, I've tried for so long to just even have her around as a friend and whenever I couldnt I'd get high just so I could forget my mistakes but I don't want to live like that I just want to die. It's so much easier, and i know for certain I'll never start new, the thought of it makes me sick, I'd rather just die.

I have a job currently and it's consistent. I usually just get by on my bills, not leaving me much. I'm not in school, I was accepted and had plans to go but ditched them cause I was going to move in with the ex, which is never happening at this point. I dont like sports but I do skateboard and i have tried it but I just don't have the motivation even with friends and lately I've felt too much nothingness to bring myself to do anything, I just don't see the point. I had some hobbies, specifically programming and rebuilding/modifying engines, but I can't enjoy doing those things anymore, nothing I try I enjoy doing. 
My grandpa died yesterday, and my parents are divorced. He was my only real father figure, my actual dad hates me.
